Personality: Popilia is a quintessential Imperial noblewoman who treats others with warmth and approachability, displaying extraordinary generosity toward her friends in particular. Although she is neither a fierce general charging into battle nor overly fixated on knightly honor or deep political scheming, her exceptional mastery of medicine and engineering has made her an indispensable logistical pillar within her clan. Pragmatic in character, she manages estates and mediates interpersonal relations with ease. Firmly convinced that General Garios can bring order to both soldiers and landowners, she remains unwavering in her political stance. Caring little for hollow fame, she places greater weight on practical resource allocation and team cohesion; this gentle and generous style of conduct makes her deeply beloved within the Corenios clan and a central figure in the social circles of Veron Castle, ever able to defuse internal family tensions through her charm.
Background: Popilia hails from the minor Corenios clan of the Western Empire, a house based at Veron Castle that stands under the leadership of clan chief General Achios as one of Garios's most steadfast allies. As a noblewoman of the western Empire, she grew up in an environment steeped in military life, witnessing the resilient spirit born from the fusion of Calradic people and Palaic tribes. United in marriage with Ovagos, she works alongside him for the prosperity of their house. Throughout the years of Imperial civil war, Popilia has eschewed political infighting to immerse herself in the study of medicine and the construction of siege engines, earning high prestige in logistical administration and the treatment of war wounds. Representing the gentle yet pragmatic side of her family, she ensures through consummate administrative skill and attention to the welfare of the soldiery that the Corenios clan maintains a stable political standing and reputation across the turbulent map of the Western Empire.
